sources.entry: Mole - Clean, uninstall, analyze, optimize, and monitor your Mac from the terminal.

summary.one_liner: Mole is a free, open-source macOS command-line toolkit (`mo`) for deep cleaning, app uninstalling, disk analysis, system optimization, and live system monitoring.
summary.what_it_does: Mole provides a set of `mo` subcommands run from the terminal: `clean` removes caches, logs, and leftovers from uninstalled apps; `uninstall` removes apps along with related LaunchAgents, preferences, and leftover files; `analyze` opens an interactive TUI disk explorer that finds large files and navigates directories; `optimize` refreshes caches and services such as DNS, QuickLook, and icon services; `status` shows a read-only live dashboard of CPU, memory, disk I/O, network, power, and processes. It also includes `purge` to remove rebuildable project artifacts like node_modules and build folders, `installer` to find and remove DMG/PKG/ISO/ZIP installer files, and `slim` to strip Intel code from universal apps. Most destructive commands support `--dry-run` previews, and a `history` command reads an operations log.
use_cases: free up disk space on a Mac
completely uninstall an app and its leftover files
find large files and folders taking up storage
clean project build artifacts like node_modules
monitor CPU, memory, and network usage from the terminal
remove old installer DMG and PKG files
notable: Preview cleanups with --dry-run and review the operations log via mo history
Uninstall moves apps to Trash by default; personal data is kept unless selected
Purge and status include JSON output modes for automation
Includes Raycast and Alfred launcher integration set up by the install script
Also has a separate native Mac app and a Windows CLI, which the README describes as distinct products
caveats: Requires macOS 12 or newer; Homebrew install may not cover older macOS versions, in which case the script install is needed
clean, purge, and installer delete permanently rather than moving to Trash
The native Mac app is a separate paid/proprietary download; this repo is the free GPL-3.0 CLI
